# Follow up when a lead goes quiet

Send one later WhatsApp message only if the lead has not replied, and skip it when a label says they already converted.

A team uses Whatsable so a lead who stops writing gets one useful message later, and a lead who already replied or already bought does not.

## Set it up

**Label the stage**

Use labels such as New, Quoted and Won. The AI agent, a keyword, an ad or a teammate can apply them. See [Labels](https://docs.whatsable.app/features/labels).

**Answer the first message**

Reply in the [inbox](https://docs.whatsable.app/features/team-inbox). Or let an [AI agent](https://docs.whatsable.app/features/ai-chatbot) answer on Growth, Pro and Agency.

**Schedule the follow-up**

Pick a template, a time, and a condition: no reply since your last message, and none of the Won label. See [Conditional follow-ups](https://docs.whatsable.app/features/conditional-follow-ups).

**Let the check run later**

Whatsable does not decide at schedule time. When the message is due, a reply or the Won label means nothing is sent.

**Hand a live lead to a person**

A handoff notifies the teammates who can see that conversation. See [Notifications](https://docs.whatsable.app/features/notifications).

This schedule is on Work, Growth, Pro and Agency, on the Free plan, and during the 14-day trial. Bulk Message does not include it. Outside the 24-hour window the follow-up has to be a template.

## FAQ

**What if they reply five minutes before the send?**

The condition fails and nothing is sent. The scheduled message records why.

**Can a broadcast do this?**

No. A broadcast has no send condition. Schedule the follow-up on its own.
